purpose.zh: 拉伸背阔肌和背部侧面
purpose.en: Stretch your lats and the sides of your back.

text.zh: 双手扶墙，臀部向后移，胸口下沉
text.en: Hands on the wall, push your hips back and let your chest sink

text.zh: 双手与胸同高，双脚踩稳，膝盖微屈
text.en: Hands at chest height, feet planted, knees soft.

text.zh: 腰部保持中立，不要硬压
text.en: Keep your lower back neutral and do not force it.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back to push deeper.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
